kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انهمكت (form VII)
# اِنْهَمَكْتُ (inhamaktu) /in.ha.mak.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# اِنْهَمَكْتَ (inhamakta) /in.ha.mak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# اِنْهَمَكْتِ (inhamakti) /in.ha.mak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# اِنْهَمَكَتْ (inhamakat) /in.ha.ma.kat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
